headline: Junior AI Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction and hands-on experience in computer vision, OCR, RAG, agentic systems, classical machine learning, and edge AI. Builds the software around AI as well: Python pipelines, APIs, validation workflows, databases, tests, containers, and cloud deployment. Especially motivated by operational AI that turns sensor and system data into reliable decisions in autonomous and maritime environments.
internship_bullets: Built a Python application that turns echocardiographic DICOM studies into structured research data using computer vision, OCR, and review tooling.
Designed resumable processing, validation queues, traceable outputs, and cross-platform documentation so the workflow could be used and extended reliably.
Reduced one representative OpenCV and metadata-based source-video matching run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes.
apolloon_bullets: Engineered a paid local-first operations platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO.
Designed operator-focused workflows, realtime synchronisation, automatic LAN discovery, replicated failover, health checks, and reliable offline operation.

projects.title: Financial AI Agent

projects.title: Offline Semi-Supervised AI in Rust
projects.description: Built and evaluated a Burn/Rust plant-disease classifier that reached 94.90% held-out accuracy and shipped as an approximately 26 MB offline application tested on iPhone.
